authoringStatement: E1 expectations were authored by hand from docs/E1_MIDI_EXPORT_CONTRACT.md before any production SMF writer existed. Every golden byte was assembled manually from the byte model in section 3 (header fields, chunk lengths, VLQ encodings, running-status runs, meta payloads, note events); every report and loss expectation was derived on paper. The validator re-parses each golden with its own minimal SMF reader and independently re-derives the expected model and report; no value was produced by, or copied from, production writer output.

classificationPolicy.primary-standard: A current normative Web platform standard.
classificationPolicy.reviewed-contract: A normative repository architecture or package decision.
classificationPolicy.legacy-observation: A reproduced legacy failure the replacement must not preserve.
classificationPolicy.mechanical-derivation: A direct result of a declared formula, integer algorithm, or cap.
classificationPolicy.human-review: A judgment that automation cannot honestly certify.

authorities.source: Standard MIDI File 1.0 specification (MMA): header/track chunk layout, big-endian integers, variable-length quantities, running status, meta event types 0x03/0x04/0x06/0x2F/0x51/0x58, time-signature payload semantics
supports: Format 1 with two tracks and 16-bit division 960
VLQ encoding and the four-byte 0x0FFFFFFF ceiling
Meta payload layouts for name, instrument, marker, tempo, time signature, end of track
MIDI note number and velocity ranges 0..127

authorities.source: docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md sections 9 (tick and tempo laws), 9.6 (nearest-microsecond tempo), 16.3 (MIDI export) plus the P0 playback-plan contract pins (PPQ 960, fixed velocity 96, gate ticks, event fields) and bead jcpe-milestone-advanced-craft-ulj.2.1
supports: Conductor-plus-voicing track split and marker content
Consume the finished plan; never reparse, revoice, or re-quantize

Stale pairing refuses; losses are reported, never silent

authorities.source: Integer arithmetic over frozen values: chunk lengths summed from event byte counts, VLQ group arithmetic, round(60000000/bpm) and its error terms, filename sanitize-truncate, byte and count caps
supports: Every chunk length, delta encoding, and byteLength in the goldens
The 4 MiB byte ceiling and marker/text caps
